bible.title: Two Claims at Willowford
bible.kernel: A lender hires the company to fetch a pledged woman and finds a rival master already on her trail.

cast.name: Herve Greyfell
cast.who: moneylender from a river town with claims that reach the forest edge

cast.name: Breduin
cast.who: forestwarden who enforces long-standing claim-lines among hamlets
cast.want: to assert his prior pledge over the woman

cast.name: Hermione
cast.who: Willowford peasant who keeps the village ditch and talks easy with neighbors
cast.want: to stay free in the village

bible.situation: Herve Greyfell has hired the company to collect a woman pledged as collateral from a village he named. The village has been answering demands from lenders and from forest claimants and cannot meet both sets of claims. The company will be paid on delivery of the pledged person to Herve.
bible.goal: to collect a pledged woman held by a village
arc: Go to the Willowford outskirts at the river and present Herve Greyfell's claim, using only what Herve supplied. → yields: Hermione, a short, gregarious peasant turning the village ditch and named by the villagers as the pledged woman.

With Hermione located, follow her trail to the ditch at Thornhollow's edge to learn who else claims her pledge. → yields: a second wooden pledge token stamped with Breduin's mark, proving a rival claim against Herve.
Return to the Willowford green with the token to force Breduin to make his stand, outwit him there, and hand the pledged woman to Herve Greyfell.
bible.twist: Hermione is legally pledged to both Herve Greyfell and Breduin; both masters hold tokens claiming her.
tensions: a second pledge in the forestwarden's hand that cancels a simple pickup
villagers who will block a forced removal of one of their own
Hermione's refusal to go without guarantees
openDirections: negotiate a split settlement or a work-for-release with Breduin to secure Herve's claim
the village's twin debts will push more pledges into circulation, drawing fresh claimants whether the company acts or not

shipped.title: Present the Claim at Willowford
shipped.situation: Herve Greyfell stands in the yard and lays a folded claim on the table. You are to collect a pledged woman held by a village. Herve says this packet is all he will give and watches you count its seals with a tired look. The village sits at Willowford's river edge. The meeting must be on the outskirts by the water. The client pays the agreed coin, and the company keeps whatever the road turns up. They say the one at the heart of this would fetch a proper ransom in the right hands.
shipped.job: Go to the Willowford river outskirts and present Herve Greyfell's claim using only what he supplied.
